_readme: Layers B and C have no free API. Updated weekly from news (later by Claude's weekly scheduled task). dir=1 means higher is worse; dir=-1 means lower is worse.

flags._note: monetization_miss: set true when Anthropic's revenue grows <15% QoQ AND compute gross margin fails to recover from 42%. capex_surprise: set true when hyperscalers' 2027 capex guidance surprises (sharp cut or sharp raise).

b_layer.name: CoreWeave 5Y CDS
b_layer.note: Peaked ~1,289bp on 11/5; a new high = red, below 800bp = all clear

b_layer.name: Oracle 5Y CDS
b_layer.note: Watch the trend: steady widening is the warning (400bp red line is provisional)

b_layer.name: AI IG bonds − other IG spread gap
b_layer.note: 11/5: AI IG 148bp vs other IG 77bp; a widening gap is the warning

b_layer.name: H100 hourly rental
b_layer.note: Below $1.65, collateral residual value heads toward zero

checklist.item: Revenue growth ≥ 15% QoQ (breakeven within 12 months needs ~14–18%)
Compute gross margin recovers from 42% (was 52% in Q2)
Quarterly newly powered capacity re-accelerates (Q2 ~500MW → Q3 ~200MW)
Powered/contracted ratio improves (now ~1.7/4.6GW, ~37%); powered >1.85GW by year-end
2027 capex guidance: big raise = bullish upstream; flat or cut = bullish hyperscalers
10-Q footnotes: commencement schedule of not-yet-commenced leases (leverage jumps the quarter they start)
Whether any of the $118bn of guarantees is actually paid out ($105bn is OpenAI's Ohio campus)
Trend in neocloud commitments ($36bn → $32bn); losses on purchase obligations
Annualized revenue news and IPO timing (largest counterparty behind ORCL, CRWV and Nvidia's guarantees)
Another round of major API price cuts = price war intensifying

calendar.event: New Ohio governor takes office (data-center permitting)
New Texas governor takes office (data-center permitting)
Hyperscaler Q4 earnings and 2027 capex guidance (from late January)
Nvidia and CoreWeave earnings; Anthropic's first report as a public company (Feb–Mar)
